repository.name: everythingAI
repository.branch_policy: Work directly on main unless the user explicitly changes this rule.

executive_summary.project_identity: EverythingAI is a validated local-first, source-backed AI knowledge workspace with a Client Workspace, Admin Dashboard, durable Knowledge Base/Wiki layer, governed planning/execution/undo, admin-selected AI providers, admin-only Agent Connectors, and green local/CI smoke validation.
executive_summary.current_phase: Phase 8.3A Connector Diagnostics UX and local validation helper work is complete and green.
executive_summary.latest_milestone: Admin Agent Connectors now has health summaries, persistent probe results, controlled setup checklists, connector-specific notes, primary connector progress, local troubleshooting guidance, and a Windows clean-and-smoke helper.
executive_summary.important_note: Phase 8.3A improved visibility and operator diagnostics only. It did not enable connector chat, did not expose connectors to Client Workspace, and did not change bridge execution defaults.

admin_connector_diagnostics_ux.description: Admin Agent Connectors shows health summary, per-connector status, next action guidance, Phase 8.3A target markers, and optional connector missing-state labels.

persistent_probe_results.description: Agent probe results persist in AdminRuntimeApp and are passed through AdminViewRouter and SettingsView into AgentConnectorsPanel.

controlled_setup_checklist.description: Codex and Claude Code cards include readiness checklists covering safe command, PATH detection, controlled enablement, bridge flag, version probe, and chat-disabled checks.

connector_specific_setup_notes.description: Codex and Claude Code cards include setup notes for command shape, external app session expectation, troubleshooting path, and ready-to-advance rule.

primary_connector_progress_snapshot.description: Admin Settings shows readiness progress for Codex and Claude Code as a concise setup-check count.

local_troubleshooting_guidance.description: Admin Settings includes local diagnostics refresh order and smoke runner cleanup reminder.

smoke_runner_port_guard.description: Local smoke runner refuses to test against stale frontend servers on port 5151 and uses strict Vite port behavior.

windows_clean_smoke_helper.description: Windows helper frees local dev ports, pulls latest main, runs typecheck, build, and smoke, then prints a reportable validation summary.

connector_state.ready_meaning: A primary connector is not treated as ready until safe command, PATH detection, controlled enablement, bridge flag, version probe, and chat-disabled checks are complete.

critical_architecture_rules: Client Workspace can chat with AI only through the backend/admin-selected active provider.
Client Workspace must not expose provider selection, API keys, remote-provider policy, planning policy, or agent connector configuration.
Admin Dashboard owns provider settings, API keys, remote-provider policy, planning rules, and Agent Connectors.
Agent bridge execution remains disabled by default.
Agent chat execution remains disabled by default.
Do not enable arbitrary shell command execution from the browser.
Do not expose Agent Connectors in Client Workspace.
Do not change human-validation governance rules.
Do not remove existing diagnostics or validation artifacts.
Do not weaken evidence/source provenance rules.

recommended_next_session_plan.step_0: Read this Phase 8.3A completion handover first, then read the Phase 8.2 Green CI baseline handover.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_1: Run git pull on main and verify the working tree is clean.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_2: Run the Windows clean-and-smoke helper or equivalent local validation.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_3: Proceed to Phase 8.3B release hardening: API key lifecycle UX, release checklist, and frontend cleanup without weakening governance.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_4: Keep connector chat disabled unless the user explicitly approves a later connector-chat phase.
recommended_next_session_plan.step_5: Create validation artifacts after each milestone-sized batch.

remaining_phase_8_3_priorities: Phase 8.3B release hardening and release checklist update.
API key lifecycle UX: saved / replace / clear visibility.
Frontend modularization and cleanup of legacy admin paths.
Richer citation/source highlighting and extracted document formatting.
Track GitHub Actions Node runtime warning maintenance.
Track frontend dependency audit warnings without force-upgrading blindly.
known_risks_and_followups: Branch protection is not yet enforced. CI validates pushes but does not block direct pushes to main unless GitHub branch protection is configured later.
Production readiness remains about 30-40%; authentication, users, tenants, secure credential storage, and production infrastructure remain later roadmap items.
Agent chat must not be enabled until connector-specific setup, security review, and explicit user approval are complete.
The Windows clean-and-smoke helper stops local Node processes on ports 4100 and 5151-5155. Use it only for EverythingAI local validation sessions.
handover_report.final_status: EverythingAI Phase 8.3A Connector Diagnostics UX and local validation helper work is complete and green. Next recommended work is Phase 8.3B release hardening.
